reason: PlayerActionKind gains FaceDilemma (a player chose one or more modes for a spell or ability; TRK face a dilemma), carried in GameEvent::PlayerPerformedAction, GameState player_actions_this_turn / player_actions_this_way and card-data TriggerDefinition.player_actions, so an older full-game or P2P peer cannot decode the tag.
